doc: Long-lived browser I/O: WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (LCP-016). The engine opens a connection and gets an opaque id; everything that happens to it arrives as facts under that id, ending with exactly one Closed. The pack never reconnects — EventSource's native retry is stopped and reported as Closed — so reconnection, backoff and replacement are the engine's decisions. Payloads are uninterpreted text.

types.name: ConnectionId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

types.name: CloseInitiator
types.doc: Who ended a connection the engine did not close (an engine's own close is answered Closed and nothing follows). remote: the server closed it. error: the connection failed, or an event stream dropped and would have retried on its own.

variants.name: openWebSocket
variants.doc: url is ws:, wss:, or http(s): (mapped to ws(s):), absolute or relative to the page.

variants.name: openEventSource
variants.doc: url is http(s):, absolute or relative to the page. Unnamed events arrive as Message; a named event type arrives only if it is listed in events (the browser offers no way to hear every type).

variants.name: send
variants.doc: Send one text message on an open WebSocket.

variants.name: close
variants.doc: Close a connection. It is answered Closed and nothing more is heard for it — not even a message the browser had already queued.

variants.name: Connecting
variants.doc: Facts for this connection follow: Opened, Message…, then exactly one Closed — unless the engine closes it first.

variants.name: NotOpen
variants.doc: send before Opened, or while closing.

variants.name: Stale
variants.doc: No such live connection: never issued here, already closed, or from before a reload.

variants.name: InvalidUrl
variants.doc: The URL does not parse, or its scheme is not one this transport takes. Named by scheme only, never by value.

variants.name: InvalidCloseCode
variants.doc: A WebSocket close code must be 1000 or 3000–4999.

variants.name: Refused
variants.doc: The browser threw (for example a content security policy). The exception's name only.

fields.name: protocol
fields.doc: The subprotocol the server chose; empty for none and for event streams.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: An event stream's event type, when not the default message.

variants.name: BinaryMessage
variants.doc: A binary WebSocket frame: its size only. Bytes do not cross.

variants.name: Closed
variants.doc: The last fact for this connection; its id is Stale from now on.
